findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - closing this fix relies on the pull request's test check.
The commit that moves the note has no Proof list, so no passing run of `tests/test_fix_old_forge_records.py` is recorded. The PR runs `forge test --change` (`.github/workflows/forge.yml:86-89`), but the picker matches only the immediate parent of a listed folder (`src/forge/docskip.py:67-83`). The test recursively scans `plans` and `.factory` (`tests/test_fix_old_forge_records.py:13-24`), while the changed files are nested beneath those folders; it is also absent from `.forge/always-tests.txt`. A green PR check therefore does not establish that the named test passed. Run the test and record its result in a Proof list.
